LSLOGTOP.source:
FUNCTION-POOL slog        NO STANDARD PAGE HEADING
                          LINE-SIZE 152.

TYPE-POOLS: trlog, sabc.

* global types
TYPES: BEGIN OF gty_stack_killer,
         ok(1) TYPE c,
         trkorr TYPE trkorr,
         method TYPE ob_method,
         methodname TYPE rs38l_fnam,
       END OF gty_stack_killer.

*----miscancellous constants--------------------------------------------
CONSTANTS: gc_translate_sep(2)   VALUE '"''',
           gc_any_filler(2)      VALUE '&$',
           filler(1)             VALUE '&',
           var_border(1)         VALUE '"',
           gc_default_language   LIKE t100-sprsl VALUE 'E',
           true                  VALUE 'X',
           false                 VALUE ' ',
           true_false(2)         VALUE ' X',
           lev1_chars(1)         VALUE '#',
           level_bad_entry(1)    TYPE n VALUE 3,
           gc_notfound_text(30)
                             VALUE 'Unknown message with & & & &'."#EC *

*& set file size to  read in compact mode (for large files).
*& In the future the value maybe raised.
CONSTANTS: gv_filesize_large  LIKE epsf-epsfilsiz VALUE 50000000.

*------return codes-----------------------------------------------------
CONSTANTS: abort_rc      LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE 'A',
           err_rc        LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE 'E',
           postupg_rc    LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE 'P',
           warn_rc       LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE 'W',
           ok_rc         LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE ' ',
           all_rc(5)                          VALUE ' WPEA',
           gc_ok_rc_alternatives(2)           VALUE 'IS'.



*------log levels-------------------------------------------------------
CONSTANTS: abort_level   LIKE sprot-level     VALUE  1,
           err_level     LIKE sprot-level     VALUE  2,
           postupg_level LIKE sprot-level     VALUE  2,
           low_level     LIKE sprot-level     VALUE  4,
           all_level(9)                       VALUE '123456789',
           gc_min_level  LIKE trlog-level     VALUE '1',
           gc_max_level  LIKE trlog-level     VALUE '9'.

* memory IDs
CONSTANTS: gc_mem_id_stack_killer(30)
              VALUE 'sCTS_stacK_kIlleR_mETh'.               "#EC NOTEXT

*--------special messages-----------------------------------------------
* Exit code message by tp
CONSTANTS: tp_rc_ag       LIKE sprot-ag    VALUE 'TP',
           tp_rc_msgnr    LIKE sprot-msgnr VALUE '111'.


*---------various variables---------------------------------------------
DATA: gv_check_levels            VALUE ' ',
      gv_error_occured           LIKE sprot-severity  VALUE ' ',
      gv_mem_file                LIKE sprot_i-prot    VALUE ' ',

      gv_mem_id_error_occured(9) VALUE 'prot_errf',
      gv_mem_id_check_levels(9)  VALUE 'prot_chkl',
      gv_mem_id(9)               VALUE 'prot_file',

      gc_master_lang1            LIKE  t100-sprsl   VALUE 'E',
      gc_master_lang2            LIKE  t100-sprsl   VALUE 'D',
      gv_language                LIKE  sy-langu,
      gv_titlebar                LIKE  sy-title,
      gv_heading1(100)           TYPE  c,
      gv_heading2(100)           TYPE  c,
      gv_refresh                 TYPE  c,
      gs_line                    LIKE  trlog,    "hide variable
      gv_with_long_text_icon     TYPE  c,
      dv_with_long_text_icon     TYPE  c,
      gv_with_line_numbers       TYPE  c,
      dv_with_line_numbers       TYPE  c,
      gv_with_message_numbers    TYPE  c,
      dv_with_message_numbers    TYPE  c,
      gv_with_level              TYPE  c,
      dv_with_level              TYPE  c,
      gv_with_refresh_icon       TYPE  c,
      gv_gui_status              TYPE  gui_status,
      gv_user_canceled           TYPE  c,
      gv_user_wants_display      TYPE  c,
      dv_fcode                   LIKE  sy-ucomm.

DATA: gt_lines                   LIKE  trlog  OCCURS 0.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_log,
         logname TYPE ddprs-protname,
         ddprs   TYPE ddprs OCCURS 0,
       END OF ts_log.
DATA: gt_logs TYPE TABLE OF ts_log.

DATA: gs_refresh_parameters     TYPE trlog_refresh_parameters,
      gv_first_time             TYPE c      VALUE 'X'.

*--- TRINT_PUT_VARS_INTO_LINE -----------------------------------------*
* table for message variables; it is a global table since
* creation of internal tables is expensive
DATA:   BEGIN OF gt_var OCCURS 4,
          v      LIKE sprot_u-var1,
          used(1),
        END OF gt_var.
DATA:   gv_gt_var_filled(1) VALUE ' '. "mark that GT_VAR has 4 entries

DATA:  BEGIN OF gt_t100 OCCURS 0.
        INCLUDE STRUCTURE t100.
DATA:    real_langu      LIKE t100-sprsl,
         not_found       LIKE sprot_i-xfeld,
       END   OF gt_t100 .
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*


************************************************************************
*  M A C R O S                                                         *
************************************************************************
DEFINE current_message_raising.
  message id     sy-msgid
          type   sy-msgty
          number sy-msgno
          with   sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
          raising  &1.
END-OF-DEFINITION.

LSLOGF03.source:
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSLOGF03                                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  READ_LOG_FILE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_log_file TABLES   pt_lines      STRUCTURE trlog
                   USING    pv_logname    LIKE tstrf01-file
                            pv_language   LIKE syst-langu
                            pv_timestamp  TYPE tstamp
                            pv_client     TYPE t000-mandt .

  DATA: ls_cont        LIKE trlogr,    "transfer container
        ls_line        LIKE trlog,
        lv_line_num    TYPE i,        " total line nummer of the log .
        lv_start_index TYPE i,
        lv_stop_index  TYPE i,
        lv_start_index_time  TYPE i, " startline if timestamp matchs,
        lv_stop_index_time  TYPE i, " lastline if timestamp matchs,
        lv_count  TYPE i VALUE 0 , " count for timestamp matchs.
        lv_timestamp_flag     TYPE c VALUE ' ' ,  " timestamp flag
        lv_client_flag TYPE c VALUE ' ',  " client flag
        lv_repid       LIKE sy-repid,
        lv_filename    LIKE authb-filename.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> LIKE trlog.
  DATA lv_filesize LIKE epsf-epsfilsiz . " filesize
  DATA lv_large_file TYPE c VALUE ' '.

  DATA:  lv_delblock1_beg  TYPE i ,
         lv_delblock1_end  TYPE i ,
         lv_delblock2_beg  TYPE   i ,
         lv_delblock2_end  TYPE   i .
*& --------------------input check-------------------
  IF pv_logname = space.
    MESSAGE e314(pu)      RAISING invalid_input.
  ENDIF.

*& -------------------Authority check ------------------------
*&  SY-REPID IS EVALUATED IN FUNCTION GROUP WHEN USED AS PARAMETER!!!
  lv_repid    = sy-repid.
  lv_filename = pv_logname.
  CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK_DATASET'
    EXPORTING
      program      = lv_repid
      activity     = sabc_act_read
      filename     = lv_filename
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_authority = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE e807(pu) WITH pv_logname   RAISING file_access_error.
  ENDIF.

*&---------------get the size of this log file---------------

  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_LOGFILE_ATTRIBUTES'
    EXPORTING
      iv_logname  = pv_logname
    IMPORTING
      ev_filesize = lv_filesize
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS      = 1.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0 .
    lv_filesize = 0 .
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_filesize > gv_filesize_large.
    MESSAGE s826(pu) WITH lv_filesize .
    lv_large_file = 'X' .  " file recongized as 'Large File '
  ENDIF.

*& ---------------- read raw log lines from OS file -------------------
  CLEAR: pt_lines[].

  TRY.
      OPEN DATASET pv_logname FOR INPUT
                              IN TEXT MODE
                              ENCODING UTF-8 IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
    CATCH cx_sy_file_open.
*       in case the file is already opened, close it and reopen it
*       again with the right parameters
      CLOSE DATASET pv_logname.
      OPEN DATASET pv_logname FOR INPUT
                              IN TEXT MODE
                              ENCODING UTF-8 IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
  ENDTRY.

  IF sy-subrc = 0.

    DO.
      READ DATASET pv_logname INTO ls_cont.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.

*& following lines will be read :
*& 1. if file not extra large all lines.
*& 2. large file :
*&   a) only error level '1,2,3' will be read.
*&   b) message class Format 3.0  and  message class
*&      format 4.0(lang message)
*&   c) lines with client info: (level 4 as exception) .

      IF  lv_large_file = ' '  OR  " normal file, all lines
          ls_cont(1) CA '123'  OR                           " level 1-3
          ( ls_cont(1) = 'A' AND ls_cont(2) CA '123' )  "lang message.
          OR ( ls_cont CS 'client' OR ls_cont CS 'Mandant' ) .
        "clieninfo .

        PERFORM convert_line USING  ls_cont
                                    pv_language
                                    CHANGING ls_line.
        APPEND ls_line TO pt_lines .

      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET pv_logname.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE e315(pu) WITH pv_logname   RAISING file_access_error.
  ENDIF.

*& ---------------- take only that part of the log where -------------
*& --------------    both timestamp and CLIENT match -------------------

*& check if timestamp initial .
  IF pv_timestamp = space.
    RETURN . "  avoid run time error.
  ENDIF.

* check if client specific.
  IF pv_client = '  ' . " not client specific
    lv_client_flag = 'X' .  " client need not be checked    .
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT pt_lines ASSIGNING <ls_line>
                   WHERE class = 'TP'
                   AND ( number = '199' " beginn line
                   OR number = '110' )  " endline
                   OR  LINE CS 'client'
                   OR  LINE CS 'Mandant' . "client line

*& begin a new section.
    IF     <ls_line>-newsection = 'X' AND <ls_line>-number = '199'.

      lv_start_index = sy-tabix. " index of the begin line
      lv_timestamp_flag        = space. " refresh in every section
      IF pv_client <> space . "   client specific refresh
        lv_client_flag = space .      .
      ENDIF.

*& check client line .
    ELSEIF   <ls_line>-line  CS 'client' AND
                         <ls_line>-line CS pv_client
             OR
         <ls_line>-line  CS 'Mandant'  AND
                         <ls_line>-line CS pv_client.
      lv_client_flag = 'X' . "client OK

*& check timestamp line.
    ELSEIF <ls_line>-newsection = ' ' AND <ls_line>-number = '110'
       AND <ls_line>-line CS pv_timestamp.
      lv_timestamp_flag        = 'X'.  " Ok,timestep correct.

*& check endline of a section
*& section end for this timestamp
    ELSEIF <ls_line>-newsection = ' ' AND <ls_line>-number = '199'  .

      IF  lv_timestamp_flag = 'X' AND lv_client_flag = 'X'  .
        lv_stop_index = sy-tabix.
        EXIT . " all OK .
      ENDIF.

*&  It's necessary to  record the  startline and stopline
*&   even only  timestamp matchs, in case there is no
*&   client line in logfile can match , noticed the line nummber .
*&   will be oversteered if  clientinfo is available in log.
      IF  lv_timestamp_flag = 'X' .
*& collect all sections , if timestamp matches.
        IF lv_count =  0 .  " start from the first matching section .
          lv_start_index_time =  lv_start_index .
        ENDIF.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1 . "ensure not start from other sect.
        lv_stop_index_time  = sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.

    ENDIF.
*& if still not jump out ,goto next section!
  ENDLOOP.

*&---------------------------- Exceptions Behandlung
*----------------------

*&  Exception  1:   given client not found :
*&     get parts which timestamp matches.
*&  if also no timestamp found  , hier get at first '0' value .
  IF lv_client_flag =  '   ' . " given client not found .
    lv_start_index = lv_start_index_time .
    lv_stop_index = lv_stop_index_time  .
  ENDIF.

*& Exception 2 : given timestamp not found .
*& including neither client nor timestamp not found : the whole log .
  IF lv_timestamp_flag = ' ' AND lv_count = 0 .
    "no time stamp gefunden .
    lv_start_index = 1.
    DESCRIBE TABLE pt_lines LINES lv_stop_index.
    MESSAGE s311(pu).
  ENDIF.

*& Exception 4:last safeguiding: lv_stop_index = 0 but lt_lines <> 0
*& take all log .
  DESCRIBE TABLE pt_lines LINES  lv_line_num .
  IF lv_stop_index = 0 AND  lv_line_num  <> 0 .
    lv_start_index = 1.
    lv_stop_index  =  lv_line_num .
    MESSAGE s311(pu).
  ENDIF .

*& --------------------  Output the result ------------------
  IF lv_stop_index = 0.
*& exception 5 : lt_lines = 0  empty log.
    MESSAGE i293(pu).
  ELSE.

*& reduce pt_lines to the required parts.

* delete block before required
    IF  lv_start_index <> 1 .
      lv_delblock1_beg  = 1 .
      lv_delblock1_end  = lv_start_index - 1  .
      DELETE pt_lines FROM lv_delblock1_beg   TO lv_delblock1_end  .
    ENDIF.

* delete block after required
    IF lv_stop_index <> lv_line_num  .
      lv_delblock2_beg = lv_stop_index - lv_start_index  + 2 .
      lv_delblock2_end = lv_line_num  - lv_start_index  +  1 .

      DELETE pt_lines FROM lv_delblock2_beg   TO lv_delblock2_end  .

    ENDIF .

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.                               " READ_LOG_FILE

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  READ_LOG_DB
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_log_db   TABLES   pt_lines    STRUCTURE trlog
                   USING    pv_logname  LIKE ddprh-protname
                            pv_language LIKE syst-langu.

  DATA: ls_cont       LIKE trlogr,     "transfer container
        ls_line       LIKE trlog,
        lt_ddprs      LIKE ddprs        OCCURS 0.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_ddprs> LIKE ddprs.

  CLEAR: pt_lines[].

  IF pv_logname = space.
    MESSAGE e314(pu)      RAISING invalid_input.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT * FROM ddprs INTO TABLE lt_ddprs WHERE protname = pv_logname
                      ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE e315(pu) WITH pv_logname  RAISING db_access_error.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT lt_ddprs ASSIGNING <ls_ddprs>.
    ls_cont = <ls_ddprs>-line.

    PERFORM convert_line    USING    ls_cont
                                     pv_language
                            CHANGING ls_line.
    APPEND ls_line TO pt_lines.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    "read_log_db

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CONVERT_LINE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM convert_line  USING    ps_cont     LIKE trlogr
                            pv_language LIKE sy-langu
                   CHANGING ps_line     LIKE trlog.

  DATA: ls_ll40            TYPE trlog_ll40,
        lv_valid_format(1),
        lv_var1            LIKE sy-msgv1.

  CLEAR: ps_line.

* analize line format of ps_cont
  PERFORM fill_ll40        USING     ps_cont
                           CHANGING  ls_ll40
                                     lv_valid_format.
  IF lv_valid_format = 'X'.
    ps_line-line       = ls_ll40-line.
    PERFORM translate_msg     USING    ls_ll40-ag ls_ll40-msgnr
                                       pv_language
                              CHANGING ps_line-line.
    ps_line-level      = ls_ll40-level.
    ps_line-severity   = ls_ll40-severity.
    ps_line-langu      = ls_ll40-langu.
    ps_line-class      = ls_ll40-ag.
    ps_line-number     = ls_ll40-msgnr.
    ps_line-newsection = ls_ll40-newobj.
    ps_line-orig_line  = ls_ll40-line.

    IF ( ps_line-class = 'PU' AND ps_line-number = '120' )
     AND ps_line-level <> 5.
      ps_line-level = 5.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    ps_line-line       = ps_cont-rawline.
    ps_line-severity   = ps_cont-rawline(1).
    ps_line-newsection = ' '.

    IF ps_line-severity CO lev1_chars.
      ps_line-level = 1.
    ELSE.
      ps_line-level = level_bad_entry.
    ENDIF.

    IF ps_line-severity CO all_rc
         AND ps_cont-rawline+1(1) CO ' -'.
      SHIFT ps_line-line BY 2 PLACES.
      IF ps_cont-rawline+2(1) EQ space.
        SHIFT ps_line-line.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      ps_line-severity = space.
    ENDIF.
* correct level for A- and E-messages ?
    IF ps_line-severity = abort_rc   AND  ps_line-level > abort_level.
      ps_line-level = abort_level.
    ENDIF.
    IF ps_line-severity = err_rc     AND  ps_line-level > err_level.
      ps_line-level = err_level.
    ENDIF.
    IF ps_line-severity = postupg_rc AND  ps_line-level > postupg_level.
      ps_line-level = postupg_level.
    ENDIF.
    ps_line-langu      = space.
    ps_line-class      = space.
    ps_line-number     = space.
    ps_line-orig_line  = space.
  ENDIF.

  IF ( ps_line-class = tp_rc_ag AND ps_line-number = tp_rc_msgnr ).
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_VARS_FROM_LINE'
      EXPORTING
        iv_line = ps_line-orig_line
      IMPORTING
        ev_var1 = lv_var1.
    CASE lv_var1.
      WHEN '0'.
      WHEN '4'.    ps_line-severity = warn_rc.
      WHEN '6'.    ps_line-severity = warn_rc.
      WHEN '8'.    ps_line-severity = err_rc.
      WHEN '12'.   ps_line-severity = abort_rc.
      WHEN OTHERS. ps_line-severity = err_rc.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    "convert_line

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM FILL_LL40                                                *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_ll40   USING     ps_cont         LIKE trlogr
                 CHANGING  ps_ll40         TYPE trlog_ll40
                           pv_valid_format TYPE c.

  DATA: ls_ll30          TYPE trlog_ll30,
        ls_ll40          TYPE trlog_ll40,
        ls_ll40_p2       TYPE trlog_ll40_p2,
        lv_msgsep_offset TYPE i.

  CLEAR: ps_ll40, pv_valid_format.
  ls_ll30 = ps_cont-rawline.
  ls_ll40 = ps_cont-rawline.

* valid 3.0 format?
* don't use ls_ll30-level, until you know, that it's a number!!!
  IF  ls_ll30(1)       CO all_level
  AND ls_ll30-severity CO all_rc
  AND ls_ll30-newobj   CO true_false.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_ll30 TO ps_ll40.
    ps_ll40-logversion = trlog_logversion_40.
    pv_valid_format = 'X'.

  ELSEIF ls_ll40-logversion = trlog_logversion_40
  AND    ls_ll40+trlog_level_offset(1) CO all_level
  AND    ls_ll40-severity CO all_rc.
*   valid 4.0 format?
*   don't use ls_ll40-level, until you know, that it's a number!!!

*   trailing blanks in AG are ommitted in the file
    IF ls_ll40-ag CA ' '. ENDIF.
    lv_msgsep_offset = sy-fdpos + trlog_ag_offset.
    ls_ll40+lv_msgsep_offset = space.
    ls_ll40_p2 = ps_cont-rawline+lv_msgsep_offset.
    IF ls_ll40_p2-newobj CO true_false.
      ps_ll40 = ls_ll40.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_ll40_p2 TO ps_ll40.
      pv_valid_format = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                                                    "fill_ll40

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM TRANSLATE_MSG                                            *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM translate_msg USING pv_ag
                         pv_msgnr
                         pv_language  LIKE sy-langu
                   CHANGING pv_line   LIKE sprot-line.
  DATA: lv_t100            LIKE t100,
        lv_not_found       LIKE sprot_i-xfeld,
        lv_var1            LIKE sy-msgv1,
        lv_var2            LIKE sy-msgv2,
        lv_var3            LIKE sy-msgv3,
        lv_var4            LIKE sy-msgv4.

* special logic for these two messages, no conversions
  IF pv_ag = 'D0' AND
    ( pv_msgnr = '313' OR pv_msgnr = '314' ).
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  lv_t100-sprsl = pv_language.
  lv_t100-arbgb = pv_ag.
  lv_t100-msgnr = pv_msgnr.

* get T100 message from buffer or database
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_T100_FROM_BUFFER'
    EXPORTING
      iv_sprsl     = lv_t100-sprsl
      iv_arbgb     = lv_t100-arbgb
      iv_msgnr     = lv_t100-msgnr
    IMPORTING
      ev_text      = lv_t100-text
      ev_not_found = lv_not_found.

  IF lv_not_found <> 'X'.
* get message variables
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_VARS_FROM_LINE'
      EXPORTING
        iv_line = pv_line
      IMPORTING
        ev_var1 = lv_var1
        ev_var2 = lv_var2
        ev_var3 = lv_var3
        ev_var4 = lv_var4.

* Replace fillers in T100 message with variables
    pv_line = lv_t100-text.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_PUT_VARS_INTO_LINE'
      EXPORTING
        iv_line          = pv_line
        iv_var1          = lv_var1
        iv_var2          = lv_var2
        iv_var3          = lv_var3
        iv_var4          = lv_var4
        iv_with_sep      = ' '
        iv_condense_vars = ' '
      IMPORTING
        ev_line          = pv_line.
  ELSE.
* T100 message not found in desired language
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_VARS_FROM_LINE'
      EXPORTING
        iv_line = pv_line
      IMPORTING
        ev_line = pv_line.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "translate_msg

LSLOGF05.source:
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSLOGF05
**----------------------------------------------------------------------
*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  EVALUATE_CHECK_LEVELS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM evaluate_check_levels.
  IF gv_check_levels <> 'Y' AND gv_check_levels <> 'N' .
    IMPORT gv_check_levels FROM MEMORY ID gv_mem_id_check_levels.
    IF gv_check_levels <> 'Y' AND gv_check_levels <> 'N' .
      gv_check_levels = 'N'.           " default
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " EVALUATE_CHECK_LEVELS

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM CONVERT_MESSAGES                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM convert_messages    TABLES pt_msgs        STRUCTURE sprot_u
                                pt_rawmsgs     structure trlogr " raw text
                                pt_ddprs       STRUCTURE ddprs
                         USING  pv_log_type
                                pv_logname_file
                                pv_logname_db
                                pv_trace_err   LIKE trpari-flag
                                pv_master_langu
                                pv_condense    LIKE trpari-flag.

  DATA: lv_hlp_level(1),
        lv_t100_text          LIKE t100-text,
        lv_subst_langu        LIKE t100-sprsl,
        ls_ll30               TYPE trlog_ll30,
        ls_ll40_p1            TYPE trlog_ll40_p1,
        ls_ll40_p2            TYPE trlog_ll40_p2,
        ls_cont               LIKE trlogr,
        lv_msgsep_offset      TYPE i,
        ls_msg                LIKE sprot_u,
        ls_sprot              LIKE sprot,
        ls_ddprs              LIKE ddprs,
        lv_with_sep           LIKE sprot_i-xfeld,
        lv_msgindex           type i,            " index - the same as in msgs
        ls_rawmsg             type trlogr.       " wa for raw text

* first try to read ERROR_OCCURED from memory if errors shall be traced
  IF pv_trace_err = 'X' AND gv_error_occured = space.
    IMPORT gv_error_occured FROM MEMORY ID gv_mem_id_error_occured.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.                  "for security
      gv_error_occured = space.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT pt_msgs INTO ls_msg.
    lv_msgindex = sy-tabix.
*--set language (files always in English)
    IF pv_log_type = trlog_type_file.
      ls_msg-langu = gc_default_language.
    ELSE.
      IF ls_msg-langu = space.
        ls_msg-langu = gc_default_language.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_msg-severity CN all_rc.
      IF ls_msg-severity CO gc_ok_rc_alternatives.
* some callers use severities 'I' or 'S' instead of ' '
        ls_msg-severity = ok_rc.
      ELSE.
* unknown severity: change it into error
        ls_msg-severity = err_rc.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    lv_hlp_level = ls_msg-level. "convert to char for string comparison
    IF lv_hlp_level CN all_level.
* change invalid level to lowest level 4
      ls_msg-level = low_level.
    ENDIF.

* decrease from level 1 to level 2, if severity <> 'A'
    IF gv_check_levels = 'Y'.
      IF ls_msg-level    =  abort_level   AND               "1
         ls_msg-severity <> abort_rc .                      "A
        ls_msg-level = err_level.                           "2
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

* Save information on errors in global variable gv_error_occured
* if errors shall be traced ( ABORT_RC and  ERR_RC are handled in the
* same way. May be distinguished in future.
    IF pv_trace_err = 'X' AND
      ( ls_msg-severity = abort_rc OR ls_msg-severity = err_rc ).
      gv_error_occured = err_rc.
    ENDIF.

* Add additional messages in special cases:
* Proceed the output routine twice in these cases
    DO 2 TIMES.
      ls_sprot-level       = ls_msg-level.
      ls_sprot-severity    = ls_msg-severity.
      ls_sprot-ag          = ls_msg-ag.
      ls_sprot-msgnr       = ls_msg-msgnr.
      ls_sprot-newobj      = ls_msg-newobj.
* p.k.: allow raw messages using TW000 (131 Chars) 11.08.2008
      sy-subrc = 1.
      if ls_msg-ag = 'TW' and ls_msg-msgnr = '000'.
        read table pt_rawmsgs into ls_rawmsg index lv_msgindex.
        ls_sprot-line = ls_rawmsg-rawline.
      endif.
      if sy-subrc <> 0.
* p.k.: end
* If master_langu equals ls_msg-LANGU:
* If master_langu is English, take German as alternative language,
* else take English as alternative language.
        IF ls_msg-langu = pv_master_langu.
          IF pv_master_langu = gc_master_lang1.
            lv_subst_langu = gc_master_lang2.
          ELSE.
            lv_subst_langu = gc_master_lang1.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          lv_subst_langu = pv_master_langu.
        ENDIF.

*     read the message text
        CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_T100_FROM_BUFFER'
          EXPORTING
            iv_sprsl       = ls_msg-langu
            iv_arbgb       = ls_msg-ag
            iv_msgnr       = ls_msg-msgnr
            iv_subst_langu = lv_subst_langu
          IMPORTING
            ev_text        = lv_t100_text
            ev_sprsl       = ls_sprot-langu.
        ls_sprot-line = lv_t100_text.

*        special logic for message d0313 and d0314 (no separators)
        IF ls_sprot-ag = 'D0' AND
         ( ls_sprot-msgnr = '313' OR ls_sprot-msgnr = '314' ).
          lv_with_sep = ' '.
        ELSE.
          lv_with_sep = 'X'.
        ENDIF.

        CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_PUT_VARS_INTO_LINE'
          EXPORTING
            iv_line          = ls_sprot-line
            iv_var1          = ls_msg-var1
            iv_var2          = ls_msg-var2
            iv_var3          = ls_msg-var3
            iv_var4          = ls_msg-var4
            iv_with_sep      = lv_with_sep
            iv_condense_vars = pv_condense
          IMPORTING
            ev_line          = ls_sprot-line.
      endif.
* decide, if message has to be written in 3.0 or 4.0 format
      IF ls_sprot-ag CA ' '. ENDIF.   "AG is truncated after first blank
      "in case of 4.0 format
      lv_msgsep_offset = sy-fdpos.
      IF lv_msgsep_offset LE 2.        "short AG: use 3.0 format
        CLEAR ls_ll30.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_sprot TO ls_ll30.
        ls_cont-rawline = ls_ll30.
      ELSE.                            "long AG: use 4.0 format
        ADD trlog_ag_offset TO lv_msgsep_offset.
        CLEAR: ls_ll40_p1, ls_ll40_p2.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_sprot TO ls_ll40_p1.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_sprot TO ls_ll40_p2.
        ls_ll40_p1-logversion = trlog_logversion_40.
        ls_cont-rawline = ls_ll40_p1.
        ls_cont-rawline+lv_msgsep_offset = ls_ll40_p2.
      ENDIF.

      CASE pv_log_type.
        WHEN trlog_type_file.
          TRANSFER ls_cont-rawline TO pv_logname_file.
        WHEN trlog_type_db.
          ls_ddprs-protname = pv_logname_db.
          ls_ddprs-line     = ls_cont-rawline.
          APPEND ls_ddprs TO pt_ddprs.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          MESSAGE e313(pu)  RAISING invalid_input.

      ENDCASE.
* now send additional messages in special cases; else exit.
      IF ls_msg-severity = postupg_rc AND sy-index = 1.
* send info that error can be repaired after upgrade finishes
        ls_msg-severity   = ok_rc.
* save old message id
        ls_msg-var1       = ls_msg-ag.
        ls_msg-var2       = ls_msg-msgnr.
        ls_msg-ag         = 'PU'.
        ls_msg-msgnr      = '139'.
        CLEAR: ls_msg-newobj, ls_msg-var3, ls_msg-var4.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDLOOP.

* export gv_error_occured to memory if errors shall be traced
  IF pv_trace_err = 'X'.
    EXPORT gv_error_occured TO MEMORY ID gv_mem_id_error_occured.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    "convert_messages

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM TRANSFORM_RETURN_CODE                                    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM transform_return_code       USING     pv_severity
                                 CHANGING  pv_rc.
  CASE pv_severity.
    WHEN ok_rc.    pv_rc = 0.
    WHEN warn_rc.  pv_rc = 4.
    WHEN err_rc.   pv_rc = 8.
    WHEN abort_rc. pv_rc = 12.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.                    "transform_return_code
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WRITE_TABLE_DDPRS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_table_ddprs TABLES   pt_ddprs STRUCTURE ddprs
                       USING    pv_logname.

  DATA: ls_ddprs            LIKE ddprs,
        ls_ddprh            LIKE ddprh,
        lv_ddprh_rc         TYPE  i,
        lv_ddprs_rc         TYPE  i,
        ls_cont             LIKE trlogr,
        ls_ll40             TYPE trlog_ll40,
        lv_valid_format     LIKE trpari-flag,
        lv_start_new_lines  TYPE sy-tabix.

* first try 'insert'; if it fails, then try a 'select for update'
* this sequence is safe if no entries are deleted from table ddprh
* {the sequence 'select for update' and 'insert' is not safe, if there
* are 2 parallel processes: both try a 'select for update' und this
* fails, then they try a insert, one succeeds, one fails...}
  ls_ddprh-protname = pv_logname.
  ls_ddprh-as4user  = sy-uname.
  ls_ddprh-as4date  = sy-datum.
  ls_ddprh-as4time  = sy-uzeit.
  ls_ddprh-lpointer = 0.
  ls_ddprh-maxsever = ok_rc.
  INSERT ddprh FROM ls_ddprh.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE * FROM ddprh INTO ls_ddprh
           WHERE protname = pv_logname.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE a842(tk) WITH 'DDPRH' RAISING db_access_error.
    ENDIF.

*   special logic: reference log: first deletion, then insert
    IF ls_ddprh-lpointer = '-1'.
      DELETE FROM ddprh WHERE protname = pv_logname.
      DELETE FROM ddprs WHERE protname = pv_logname.

      ls_ddprh-protname = pv_logname.
      ls_ddprh-as4user  = sy-uname.
      ls_ddprh-as4date  = sy-datum.
      ls_ddprh-as4time  = sy-uzeit.
      ls_ddprh-lpointer = 0.
      ls_ddprh-maxsever = ok_rc.
      INSERT ddprh FROM ls_ddprh.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE a842(tk) WITH 'DDPRH' RAISING db_access_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
*   insert was successful -> delete ddprs for safety reasons...
    DELETE FROM ddprs WHERE protname = pv_logname.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM transform_return_code    USING    ls_ddprh-maxsever
                                   CHANGING lv_ddprh_rc.

* Check, if new log lines will fit into ddprs.
* Clean up ddprs if necessary.
  PERFORM handle_overflow TABLES     pt_ddprs
                          USING      pv_logname
                          CHANGING   lv_start_new_lines
                                     ls_ddprh-lpointer.

  LOOP AT pt_ddprs INTO ls_ddprs.

    ADD 1 TO ls_ddprh-lpointer.
    ls_ddprs-ddposition = ls_ddprh-lpointer.

    IF sy-tabix GE lv_start_new_lines.
* this is a new log line, which was not yet in ddprs
      ls_cont = ls_ddprs-line.
      PERFORM fill_ll40     USING    ls_cont
                            CHANGING ls_ll40
                                     lv_valid_format.
      IF lv_valid_format = 'X'.
        PERFORM transform_return_code    USING    ls_ll40-severity
                                         CHANGING lv_ddprs_rc.
        IF lv_ddprs_rc > lv_ddprh_rc.
          lv_ddprh_rc       = lv_ddprs_rc.
          ls_ddprh-maxsever = ls_ll40-severity.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY pt_ddprs FROM ls_ddprs.
  ENDLOOP.

  INSERT ddprs FROM TABLE pt_ddprs.
  UPDATE ddprh FROM ls_ddprh.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE a842(tk) WITH 'DDPRH' RAISING db_access_error.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                               " WRITE_TABLE_DDPRS

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  OPEN_OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM open_output TABLES   pt_ddprs      STRUCTURE ddprs
                 USING    pv_log_type
                          pv_logname_file.
  DATA: lv_repid        LIKE sy-repid,
        lv_file         LIKE authb-filename,
        lv_message(100) TYPE c,
        lv_msgv1        LIKE sy-msgv1,
        lv_msgv2        LIKE sy-msgv1.

  CASE pv_log_type.
    WHEN trlog_type_file.

*     SY-REPID is evaluated in function group when used as parameter!!!
      lv_repid = sy-repid.
      lv_file  = pv_logname_file.
      CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK_DATASET'
        EXPORTING
          program      = lv_repid
          activity     = sabc_act_write
          filename     = lv_file
        EXCEPTIONS
          no_authority = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE e808(pu) WITH pv_logname_file
                         RAISING file_access_error.
      ENDIF.
      TRY.
        OPEN DATASET pv_logname_file MESSAGE lv_message
                                     FOR APPENDING
                                     IN TEXT MODE
                                     ENCODING UTF-8
                                     IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_open.
*       in case the file is already opened, close it and reopen it
*       again with the right parameters
        CLOSE DATASET pv_logname_file.
        OPEN DATASET pv_logname_file MESSAGE lv_message
                                     FOR APPENDING
                                     IN TEXT MODE
                                     ENCODING UTF-8
                                     IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
      ENDTRY.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_msgv1   = lv_message(50).
        lv_msgv2   = lv_message+50(50).
        MESSAGE e814(pu) WITH pv_logname_file lv_msgv1 lv_msgv2
                         RAISING file_access_error.
      ENDIF.
    WHEN trlog_type_db.
      CLEAR pt_ddprs[].
    WHEN OTHERS.
      MESSAGE e313(pu)  RAISING invalid_input.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                               " OPEN_OUTPUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CLOSE_OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM close_output TABLES   pt_ddprs        STRUCTURE ddprs
                  USING    pv_log_type     TYPE trlog_type
                           pv_logname_file LIKE tstrf01-file
                           pv_logname_db   LIKE ddprh-protname.

  CASE pv_log_type.
    WHEN trlog_type_file.
      CLOSE DATASET pv_logname_file.

    WHEN trlog_type_db.
      PERFORM write_table_ddprs      TABLES pt_ddprs
                                     USING  pv_logname_db.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      MESSAGE e313(pu)  RAISING invalid_input.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                               " CLOSE_OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  handle_overflow
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM handle_overflow       TABLES pt_ddprs STRUCTURE ddprs
                            USING pv_logname
                         CHANGING pv_start_new_lines  TYPE sy-tabix
                                  pv_counter  LIKE ddprh-lpointer.

  CONSTANTS: lc_del_beg   LIKE ddprh-lpointer  VALUE '20000',
             lc_del_end   LIKE ddprh-lpointer  VALUE '79999',
             lc_max_lines  TYPE i               VALUE 99999.

  DATA: lt_ddprs LIKE ddprs OCCURS 0,
        lv_lines_cnt TYPE i,
        lv_sum TYPE i.

* check if log lines will fit into table ddprs
  DESCRIBE TABLE pt_ddprs LINES lv_lines_cnt.
  lv_sum = lv_lines_cnt + pv_counter.

  IF lv_sum LE lc_max_lines.
* lines fit into ddprs
    pv_start_new_lines = 1.
  ELSE.
* lines do not fit into ddprs. Delete lines between lc_del_beg and
* lc_del_end.
    lt_ddprs = pt_ddprs[].
    SELECT * FROM ddprs INTO TABLE pt_ddprs
             WHERE protname = pv_logname
             AND   ddposition GT lc_del_end.
    pv_start_new_lines = sy-dbcnt + 1.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_ddprs TO pt_ddprs.
    DELETE FROM ddprs WHERE protname   = pv_logname
                      AND ddposition GE lc_del_beg.
    pv_counter = lc_del_beg - 1.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " handle_overflow

LSLOGF07.source:
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSLOGF07                                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  READ_LOG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM READ_LOG         TABLES PT_LINES           STRUCTURE TRLOG
                      USING  PV_LOG_TYPE        TYPE TRLOG_TYPE
                             PV_LOGNAME_FILE    LIKE TSTRF01-FILE
                             PV_LOGNAME_DB      LIKE DDPRH-PROTNAME
                             PV_LOGNAME_MEMORY  LIKE TSTRF01-FILENAME
                             PV_LANGUAGE        LIKE SYST-LANGU
                             PV_TIMESTAMP       TYPE TSTAMP
                             PV_CLIENT TYPE T000-MANDT .

  DATA: LT_LOG     LIKE TRLOGM   OCCURS 0.

  CASE PV_LOG_TYPE.
*----------------------------------------------- read log from file ----
    WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_FILE.

      IF PV_LOGNAME_FILE = SPACE.
        MESSAGE E314(PU)   RAISING INVALID_INPUT.
      ENDIF.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_LOG'
           EXPORTING
                IV_LOG_TYPE     = TRLOG_TYPE_FILE
                IV_LOGNAME_FILE = PV_LOGNAME_FILE
                IV_TIMESTAMP    = PV_TIMESTAMP
                IV_CLIENT       = PV_CLIENT
                IV_LANGUAGE     = PV_LANGUAGE
           TABLES
                ET_LINES        = PT_LINES
           EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS          = 1.
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING ACCESS_ERROR.
      ENDIF.

*------------------------------------------- read log from database ----
    WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_DB.

      IF PV_LOGNAME_DB = SPACE.
        MESSAGE E314(PU)   RAISING INVALID_INPUT.
      ENDIF.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_LOG'
           EXPORTING
                IV_LOG_TYPE   = TRLOG_TYPE_DB
                IV_LOGNAME_DB = PV_LOGNAME_DB
                IV_LANGUAGE   = PV_LANGUAGE
           TABLES
                ET_LINES      = PT_LINES
           EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS        = 1.
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING ACCESS_ERROR.
      ENDIF.

*------------------------------------------- read log from database ----
    WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_MEMORY.

      IF PV_LOGNAME_MEMORY = SPACE.
        MESSAGE E314(PU)   RAISING INVALID_INPUT.
      ENDIF.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_LOG_FROM_MEMORY'
           EXPORTING
                IV_LOGNAME_MEMORY = PV_LOGNAME_MEMORY
                IV_FREE_MEMORY    = ' '
           TABLES
                ET_LOG            = LT_LOG
           EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS            = 1.
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING ACCESS_ERROR.
      ENDIF.

      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CONVERT_LOG'
           TABLES
                IT_LOG   = LT_LOG
                ET_LINES = PT_LINES.

*------------------------------------other types are not valid----------
    WHEN OTHERS.
      MESSAGE E313(PU)  RAISING INVALID_INPUT.
  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                               " READ_LOG

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  DISPLAY_LOG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM DISPLAY_LOG         TABLES PT_LINES           STRUCTURE TRLOG
                         USING  PV_TITLEBAR        LIKE SY-TITLE
                                PV_HEADING         LIKE TRLOG-LINE
                                PV_DISPLAY_LEVEL   LIKE SPROT-LEVEL
                                PV_LANGUAGE        LIKE SYST-LANGU
                         CHANGING
                                PV_WITH_LONG_TEXT_ICON  LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PV_WITH_LINE_NUMBERS    LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PV_WITH_MESSAGE_NUMBERS LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PV_WITH_LEVEL           LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PV_WITH_REFRESH_ICON    LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PV_REFRESH              LIKE TRPARI-FLAG
                                PS_REFRESH_PARAMETERS
                                          TYPE TRLOG_REFRESH_PARAMETERS.

  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_DISPLAY_LOG'
       EXPORTING
            IV_DISPLAY_LEVEL        = PV_DISPLAY_LEVEL
            IV_WITH_REFRESH_ICON    = PV_WITH_REFRESH_ICON
            IV_TITLEBAR             = PV_TITLEBAR
            IV_HEADING1             = PV_HEADING
            IV_HEADING2             = ' '
            IV_LANGUAGE             = PV_LANGUAGE
       IMPORTING
            EV_REFRESH              = PV_REFRESH
       TABLES
            CT_LINES                = PT_LINES
       CHANGING
            CV_WITH_LONG_TEXT_ICON  = PV_WITH_LONG_TEXT_ICON
            CV_WITH_LINE_NUMBERS    = PV_WITH_LINE_NUMBERS
            CV_WITH_MESSAGE_NUMBERS = PV_WITH_MESSAGE_NUMBERS
            CV_WITH_LEVEL           = PV_WITH_LEVEL
            CS_REFRESH_PARAMETERS   = PS_REFRESH_PARAMETERS.

ENDFORM.                               "DISPLAY_LOG

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM SET_HEADINGS                                             *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM SET_HEADINGS              USING PV_LOG_TYPE     TYPE TRLOG_TYPE
                                     PV_LOGNAME_FILE
                                     PV_LOGNAME_DB
                                     PV_TITLEBAR
                               CHANGING PV_HEADING   LIKE TRLOG-LINE.

  IF PV_HEADING = SPACE.
    CASE PV_LOG_TYPE.
      WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_FILE.
        PV_HEADING    = TEXT-H01.
        PV_HEADING+25 = PV_LOGNAME_FILE.
      WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_DB.
        PV_HEADING    = TEXT-H02.
        PV_HEADING+25 = PV_LOGNAME_DB.
      WHEN TRLOG_TYPE_MEMORY.
        PV_HEADING    = PV_TITLEBAR.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM REFRESH_LOG                                              *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM REFRESH_LOG       TABLES PT_LINES       STRUCTURE TRLOG
                              PT_LINES_OLD   STRUCTURE TRLOG.

  DATA: LS_LINE       LIKE TRLOG,
        LV_LINES      TYPE I,
        LV_LINES_OLD  TYPE I,
        LV_START_LINE TYPE I,
        LV_LEVEL      LIKE TRLOG-LEVEL.

* if old table is empty, it is the first loop and there's nothing to do
  DESCRIBE TABLE PT_LINES_OLD  LINES LV_LINES_OLD.
  IF LV_LINES_OLD < 1.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  MESSAGE S318(PU).                    "log was read anew

  DESCRIBE TABLE PT_LINES      LINES LV_LINES.
  IF LV_LINES_OLD >= LV_LINES.         " log has not become longer
    PT_LINES[] = PT_LINES_OLD[].
    CLEAR: PT_LINES_OLD[].

    EXIT.                              "nothing more to do
  ENDIF.

* now the new log is longer than the old one
* we assume that the old log is identical to the new log up to line
* lv_lines_old; the layout is still stored in the table pt_lines_old

  PERFORM GET_HIGHEST_VISIBLE_LEVEL_ALL    TABLES PT_LINES_OLD
                                           USING  LV_LEVEL.


  LV_START_LINE = LV_LINES_OLD + 1.

  LOOP AT PT_LINES FROM LV_START_LINE
                   INTO LS_LINE.
    IF LS_LINE-LEVEL <= LV_LEVEL.
      LS_LINE-INVISIBLE = ' '.
    ELSE.
      LS_LINE-INVISIBLE = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND LS_LINE TO PT_LINES_OLD.
  ENDLOOP.

  CLEAR: PT_LINES[].
  PT_LINES[] = PT_LINES_OLD[].
  CLEAR: PT_LINES_OLD[].

ENDFORM.

LSLOGF15.source:
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSLOGF15                                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM MAIN_WRITER                                              *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* FORM MAIN_WRITER stellt den Kern des Protokollschreibers dar.
* Sie wird auch von anderen Funktionsbausteinen der Funktionsgruppe
* SPUT aufgerufen.                                                    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM main_writer TABLES xprs              STRUCTURE ddprs
                        xmsg              STRUCTURE sprot_u
                 USING  pv_log_type       TYPE trlog_type
                        pv_logname_file   LIKE tstrf01-file
                        pv_logname_db     LIKE ddprh-protname
                        pv_logname_memory LIKE tstrf01-filename
                        pv_open_output    LIKE trpari-flag
                        pv_close_output   LIKE trpari-flag
                        pv_master_langu   LIKE t100-sprsl
                        pv_condense       LIKE sprot_i-xfeld
                        pv_trace_err.

  DATA: ls_cont         LIKE trlogr,
        ls_ll40         TYPE trlog_ll40,
        lv_valid_format LIKE trpari-flag,
        lv_rc_header    TYPE i,
        lv_rc_line      TYPE i,
        lv_severity     LIKE sprot-severity,
        xout            LIKE sprot,
        ls_ddprh        LIKE ddprh,
        lv_message(100) TYPE c,
        lv_msgv1        LIKE sy-msgv1,
        lv_msgv2        LIKE sy-msgv1.

  CLEAR:  xout, xprs.

*----------open output ( open file / clear ddprs / clear memory )-------
  IF pv_open_output = 'X'.
    CASE pv_log_type.
      WHEN trlog_type_file.
        TRY.
          OPEN DATASET pv_logname_file MESSAGE lv_message
                                       FOR APPENDING
                                       IN TEXT MODE
                                       ENCODING UTF-8
                                       IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
        CATCH cx_sy_file_open.
*         in case the file is already opened, close it and reopen it
*         again with the right parameters
          CLOSE DATASET pv_logname_file.
          OPEN DATASET pv_logname_file MESSAGE lv_message
                                       FOR APPENDING
                                       IN TEXT MODE
                                       ENCODING UTF-8
                                       IGNORING CONVERSION ERRORS.
        ENDTRY.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_msgv1   = lv_message(50).
          lv_msgv2   = lv_message+50(50).
          MESSAGE a814(pu) WITH pv_logname_file lv_msgv1 lv_msgv2
                           RAISING file_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN trlog_type_db.
        REFRESH xprs.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Read global variable GV_CHECK_LEVELS from memory, if not yet filled
  PERFORM evaluate_check_levels.

* process the messages
  PERFORM msg_output TABLES xmsg
                            xprs
                     USING  xout
                            pv_master_langu
                            pv_condense
                            pv_log_type
                            pv_logname_file
                            pv_logname_db
                            pv_logname_memory
                            pv_trace_err.

*---------close output (close file/write to ddprh)----------------------
  IF pv_close_output = 'X'.
    CASE pv_log_type.
      WHEN trlog_type_file.
        CLOSE DATASET pv_logname_file.
      WHEN trlog_type_db.
*       select single for update * from ddprh into ls_ddprh"@@@@@@@@@@@q
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM ddprh INTO ls_ddprh
               WHERE protname = pv_logname_db.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          ls_ddprh-protname = pv_logname_db.
          ls_ddprh-as4user  = sy-uname.
          ls_ddprh-as4date  = sy-datum.
          ls_ddprh-as4time  = sy-uzeit.
          ls_ddprh-lpointer = 0.
          ls_ddprh-maxsever = ' '.
          INSERT ddprh FROM ls_ddprh.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            MESSAGE a842(tk) WITH 'DDPRH' RAISING sql_error.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        PERFORM get_rc            USING ls_ddprh-maxsever lv_rc_header.
        LOOP AT xprs.
          ADD 1 TO ls_ddprh-lpointer.
          xprs-ddposition = ls_ddprh-lpointer.

          ls_cont = xprs-line.
          PERFORM fill_ll40     USING    ls_cont
                                CHANGING ls_ll40
                                         lv_valid_format.
          IF lv_valid_format = 'X'.
            lv_severity = ls_ll40-severity.
            PERFORM get_rc          USING lv_severity lv_rc_line.
            IF lv_rc_line > lv_rc_header.
              lv_rc_header = lv_rc_line.
              ls_ddprh-maxsever = lv_severity.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.

          MODIFY xprs.
        ENDLOOP.

        INSERT ddprs FROM TABLE xprs.
        UPDATE ddprh FROM ls_ddprh.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE a842(tk) WITH 'DDPRH' RAISING sql_error.
        ENDIF.

    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

ENDFORM.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM MSG_OUTPUT                                               *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM msg_output TABLES xmsg STRUCTURE sprot_u
                       xprs STRUCTURE ddprs
                USING  xout  STRUCTURE sprot
                       pv_master_langu   LIKE t100-sprsl
                       pv_condense       LIKE sprot_i-xfeld
                       pv_log_type       TYPE trlog_type
                       pv_logname_file   LIKE tstrf01-file
                       pv_logname_db     LIKE ddprh-protname
                       pv_logname_memory LIKE tstrf01-filename
                       pv_trace_err.

  DATA: lv_hlp_level(1),
        lv_t100_text     LIKE t100-text,
        lv_subst_langu   LIKE t100-sprsl,
        ls_ll30          TYPE trlog_ll30,
        ls_ll40_p1       TYPE trlog_ll40_p1,
        ls_ll40_p2       TYPE trlog_ll40_p2,
        ls_cont          LIKE trlogr,
        lv_msgsep_offset TYPE i.

*--set language (files always in English)-------------------------------
  IF pv_log_type = trlog_type_file.
    xmsg-langu = gc_default_language.
    MODIFY xmsg TRANSPORTING langu
                WHERE langu <> gc_default_language.
  ELSE.
    xmsg-langu = gc_default_language.
    MODIFY xmsg TRANSPORTING langu
                WHERE langu = space.
  ENDIF.

* first try to read ERROR_OCCURED from memory if errors shall be traced
  IF pv_trace_err EQ 'X' AND gv_error_occured EQ space.
    IMPORT gv_error_occured FROM MEMORY ID gv_mem_id_error_occured.
* for security
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      gv_error_occured = space.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT xmsg.
    IF xmsg-severity CN all_rc.
      IF xmsg-severity CO gc_ok_rc_alternatives.
* some callers use severities 'I' or 'S' instead of ' '
        xmsg-severity = ok_rc.
      ELSE.
* unknown severity: chnage it into error
        xmsg-severity = err_rc.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

* convert to char for string comparison
    lv_hlp_level = xmsg-level.
    IF lv_hlp_level CN all_level.
* change invalid level to lowest level 4
      xmsg-level = low_level.
    ENDIF.

* increase too low levels, if GV_CHECK_LEVELS = 'Y'
    IF gv_check_levels EQ 'Y'.
      IF xmsg-level    EQ abort_level   AND
         xmsg-severity NE abort_rc .
        xmsg-level = err_level.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

* Save information on errors in global variable ERROR_OCCURED "ctup22
* if errors shall be traced
*  ABORT_RC and  ERR_RC are handled in the same way. May be
* distinguished in future.
    IF pv_trace_err EQ 'X' AND
       xmsg-severity EQ abort_rc OR xmsg-severity EQ err_rc.
      gv_error_occured = err_rc.
    ENDIF.

* Add additional messages in special cases:
* Proceed the output routine twice in these cases
    DO 2 TIMES.
* fill structure xout.
      xout-level       = xmsg-level.
      xout-severity    = xmsg-severity.
      xout-ag          = xmsg-ag.
      xout-msgnr       = xmsg-msgnr.
      xout-newobj      = xmsg-newobj.

* If master_langu equals XMSG-LANGU:
* If master_langu is English, take German as alternative language,
* else take English as alternative language.
      IF xmsg-langu EQ pv_master_langu.
        IF pv_master_langu EQ gc_master_lang1.
          lv_subst_langu = gc_master_lang2.
        ELSE.
          lv_subst_langu = gc_master_lang1.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        lv_subst_langu = pv_master_langu.
      ENDIF.

* read the message text
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_GET_T100_FROM_BUFFER'
           EXPORTING
                iv_sprsl       = xmsg-langu
                iv_arbgb       = xmsg-ag
                iv_msgnr       = xmsg-msgnr
                iv_subst_langu = lv_subst_langu
           IMPORTING
                ev_text        = lv_t100_text
                ev_sprsl       = xout-langu.
      xout-line = lv_t100_text.

      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_PUT_VARS_INTO_LINE'
           EXPORTING
                iv_line          = xout-line
                iv_var1          = xmsg-var1
                iv_var2          = xmsg-var2
                iv_var3          = xmsg-var3
                iv_var4          = xmsg-var4
                iv_with_sep      = 'X'
                iv_condense_vars = pv_condense
           IMPORTING
                ev_line          = xout-line.

* decide, if message has to be written in 3.0 or 4.0 format
      IF xout-ag CA ' '. ENDIF.   "AG is truncated after first blank
                                       "in case of 4.0 format
      lv_msgsep_offset = sy-fdpos.
      IF lv_msgsep_offset LE 2.        "short AG: use 3.0 format
        CLEAR ls_ll30.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING xout TO ls_ll30.
        ls_cont-rawline = ls_ll30.
      ELSE.                            "long AG: use 4.0 format
        ADD trlog_ag_offset TO lv_msgsep_offset.
        CLEAR: ls_ll40_p1, ls_ll40_p2.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING xout TO ls_ll40_p1.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING xout TO ls_ll40_p2.
        ls_ll40_p1-logversion = trlog_logversion_40.
        ls_cont-rawline = ls_ll40_p1.
        ls_cont-rawline+lv_msgsep_offset = ls_ll40_p2.
      ENDIF.

      CASE pv_log_type.
        WHEN trlog_type_file.
          TRANSFER ls_cont-rawline TO pv_logname_file.
        WHEN trlog_type_db.
          xprs-protname = pv_logname_db.
          xprs-line = ls_cont-rawline.
          APPEND xprs.
        WHEN trlog_type_memory.
          WRITE: / ls_cont-rawline.
      ENDCASE.

* now send additional messages in special cases; else exit.
      IF xmsg-severity EQ postupg_rc AND sy-index EQ 1.
* send info that error can be repaired after upgrade finishes
        xmsg-severity   = ok_rc          .
* save old message id
        xmsg-var1       = xmsg-ag        .
        xmsg-var2       = xmsg-msgnr     .
        xmsg-ag         = 'PU'           .
        xmsg-msgnr      = '139'          .
        MOVE space TO: xmsg-newobj, xmsg-var3, xmsg-var4.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDLOOP.

* export ERROR_OCCURED to memory if errors shall be traced   "ctup22
  IF pv_trace_err EQ 'X'.
    EXPORT gv_error_occured TO MEMORY ID gv_mem_id_error_occured.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM GET_RC                                                   *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_rc             USING pv_severity pv_returncode.
  CASE pv_severity.
    WHEN ok_rc.    pv_returncode = 0.
    WHEN warn_rc.  pv_returncode = 4.
    WHEN err_rc.   pv_returncode = 8.
    WHEN abort_rc. pv_returncode = 12.
    WHEN OTHERS.   pv_returncode = 0.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.
